headline: Control AirPatrol air conditioning from Home Assistant
intro: Connect an AirPatrol WiFi unit to Home Assistant after configuring it in the native Airpatrol application. The integration creates climate controls and room temperature and humidity sensors for each air conditioning system it finds.
highlights: Configure the Airpatrol WiFi unit and its Wi-Fi connection in the native Airpatrol application before setup
Sign in with the email and password for your Airpatrol application account
Control HVAC mode, target temperature, fan mode, and swing mode; Home Assistant polls the Airpatrol cloud every minute

flow.title: From Airpatrol WiFi to climate controls
stages: Configure the Airpatrol WiFi unit in the native Airpatrol application
Add AirPatrol from Settings → Devices & services and enter the account email and password
Use the climate entity and view room temperature and humidity sensors
